meta.description: Turns enrichResult, gseaResult, and compareClusterResult objects into redundancy-aware enrichplot figures.
meta.reaudit_of: The rejected 1ccf2f05a3ca93452d2517e1cff2f3e9f2e77b54 report is superseded by this fresh final-pass execution; the earlier 93/100 audit remains archived at F:/OpenScience/audits/_pre-fix-20260923/bio-pathway-enrichment-visualization/.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: Explicitly synthetic audit data produced observed values only; no clinical, efficacy, or citation claims were invented.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill visualizes researcher-supplied enrichment objects and makes no individual diagnostic or treatment recommendation.

methodological_ground.detail: Executed routes preserve signed NES, reject GSEA barplots, distinguish GeneRatio from fold enrichment, require S4 objects for similarity plots, and redirect flat lists to REVIGO.

code_usability.detail: All seven inputs, two regression probes, and hash-matched shipped ORA/GSEA examples exited 0 in the private R 4.5.2 runtime; the saved validator checked artifacts and logs.

functional_suitability.note: Covers ORA, GSEA, compareCluster, redundancy display or collapse, encoding choices, specialized plots, and scope boundaries.

reliability.note: Documents class dispatch, optional dependencies, empty-result handling, API inspection, and clean process-exit verification.

performance_context.note: The compact 249-line Skill keeps the decision tree, thresholds, and failure modes local; the detailed table is justified for this multi-plot Skill.

agent_usability.note: Object contract, decision tree, taxonomy, code fragments, defaults, and failure-to-fix mappings are directly actionable.

human_usability.note: The short guide is prompt-oriented, but it still mentions the superseded compareCluster treeplot crash.

security.note: No credentials, raw command evaluation, destructive operations, or sensitive-data retention pattern appears in source.

maintainability.note: SKILL.md and the shipped ORA example use the corrected treeplot API; one stale usage-guide phrase remains.

agent_specific.note: Precise triggers, explicit scope handoffs, and S4/optional-dependency escape hatches prevent invented outputs; guide inconsistency is minor friction.

key_strengths: All seven realistic Mode A routes, two regression probes, and exact shipped ORA/GSEA examples exit cleanly in a private package-complete runtime.
The Skill clearly separates displaying redundancy from collapsing it and demonstrates both with executable ORA routes.
The signed-NES GSEA route explicitly prevents invalid barplot interpretation and confirms the absent method dynamically.
The corrected nCluster treeplot API is independently tested for enrichResult and compareClusterResult.

recommendations.title: Remove stale treeplot-crash wording from usage guide
recommendations.problem: usage-guide.md still says that SKILL.md covers a treeplot-on-compareClusterResult crash, although the current Skill and fresh enrichplot 1.30.5 probe document and execute the working nCluster route.
recommendations.root_cause: The Phase 1 source correction updated SKILL.md and the shipped ORA example but did not synchronize the guide's brief failure-mode summary.
recommendations.fix: Replace the crash reference with current version-sensitive guidance: use nCluster in the tested runtime and perform a small compareCluster treeplot render after an enrichplot or ggtree upgrade.
